claims.claim_text_normalized: The Region Proposal Network (RPN) is a fully convolutional network that simultaneously predicts object bounds and objectness scores at each position.
claims.evidence_quote_short: An RPN is a fully convolutional network that simultaneously predicts object bounds and objectness scores at each position.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Faster R-CNN with VGG-16 achieves a frame rate of 5fps on a GPU while achieving state-of-the-art object detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC 2007, 2012, and MS COCO datasets with only 300 proposals per image.
claims.evidence_quote_short: our detection system has a frame rate of 5fps ( including all steps ) on a GPU, while achieving state-of-the-art object detection accuracy on PASCAL VOC 2007, 2012, and MS COCO datasets with only 300 proposals per image.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The RPN shares full-image convolutional features with the detection network, enabling nearly cost-free region proposals.
claims.evidence_quote_short: we introduce a Region Proposal Network (RPN) that shares full-image convolutional features with the detection network, thus enabling nearly cost-free region proposals.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using RPN with Fast R-CNN achieves an mAP of 59.9% on PASCAL VOC 2007 with up to 300 proposals, outperforming Selective Search and EdgeBoxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: RPN with Fast R-CNN achieves competitive results, with an mAP of 59.9% while using up to 300 proposals.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The anchor-based method is more cost-efficient than image pyramids or filter pyramids for addressing multiple scales and aspect ratios.
claims.evidence_quote_short: our anchor-based method is built on a pyramid of anchors, which is more cost-efficient.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The RPN alone takes only 10ms computing the additional layers when convolutional features are shared.
claims.evidence_quote_short: With the convolutional features shared, the RPN alone only takes 10ms computing the additional layers.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The translation-invariant property of anchors reduces the model size compared to MultiBox.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The translation-invariant property also reduces the model size.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The two-stage Faster R-CNN system outperforms a one-stage dense sliding window system by 4.8% mAP on PASCAL VOC 2007.
claims.evidence_quote_short: the one-stage system has an mAP of 53.9%. This is lower than the two-stage system (58.7%) by 4.8%.
